name: Hail of Razor Stones AP OLD
description: When a concealed cord is tripped, several sharp stones fall onto the square containing the cord.
disable: DC 18 Thievery (trained) to safely cut the trip cord

generalAbilities.name: Deadfall
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks into the square containing the trip cord

Effect Falling rocks deal 4d8 Slashing Damage damage (Basic DC 19 Reflex Saving Throw) to any creature in the square, possibly pinning them to the ground. On a failed save, the creature falls Prone; on a critical failure, the creature is Immobilized (DC 17 to Escape).

An adjacent creature can attempt a Basic DC 19 Athletics check to shove the rocks aside to free an immobilized creature.
